inquisition.desc: Damage dealt by Dusk Blade now has a 15% chance to reduce the mana cost of your next Purifier's Edge by -100%. This effect has a 25% chance to not be consumed by Purifier's Edge.

inquisition.name: Stake
inquisition.desc: Drive your concealed stake into the chest of an injured enemy, dealing AP Physical damage.Grants Flames of Sin and increases the duration by 3 sec.Only usable on enemies at or below 35% health.

inquisition.name: Hunt
inquisition.desc: 2 Charges, 25 sec rechargeCharge an enemy, slowing their movement speed by -70% for 2 seconds and generating 20 Rage.

inquisition.name: Interrogator
inquisition.desc: Level 20 PassiveDamage dealt by Dawn Blade now deals an additional 100% of the damage dealt over 10 seconds as Fire damage.

inquisition.name: Fiery Judgement
inquisition.desc: Judge an enemy, dealing fire SP Fire damage to them and nearby enemies.Grants Flames of Sin or increases the duration by 3 sec.

inquisition.name: Purifier's Edge
inquisition.desc: Strike an enemy with searing blades, dealing Weapon Damage plus 20 with both weapons as Fire damage.Grants Flames of Sin or increases the duration by 3 sec.

inquisition.name: Darkslayer's Lantern
inquisition.desc: Empower a lantern with your Flames of Sin and let it shine, dealing AP Fire damage and stunning all enemies within 5 yds for 5 seconds.

inquisition.name: Brooding Hatred
inquisition.desc: Increases your off-hand Weapon Damage by 20% and increases your chance to hit by 3%. (up to 2 ranks)

inquisition.name: Flexible Fighter
inquisition.desc: Increases your Agility by 6%.

inquisition.name: Smite Evil
inquisition.desc: Strike an enemy with your blade, dealing Weapon Damage plus 25 as Holy damage to them and 5 nearby enemies.

inquisition.name: Sermon of Flame
inquisition.desc: Increases your Fire damage dealt by 5%. (up to 2 ranks)

inquisition.name: Dawn
inquisition.desc: Dealing Fire damage now increases the damage dealt by Torchlight and Dusk Blade by 2% for 5 seconds, stacking 10 times.

inquisition.name: Searing Hilt
inquisition.desc: Purifier's Edge now grants you Searing Hilt for 10 seconds.Searing HiltIncreases your melee attack speed by 10% for 10 seconds.

inquisition.name: Flourish
inquisition.desc: Perform an advanced flourish, dealing AP Fire damage to nearby enemies, repeating every 4 sec, and causing your Flames of Sin to cleave up to 3 additional enemies for 20 seconds.Grants you Flames of Sin and increases the duration by 10 sec.

inquisition.name: Dusk
inquisition.desc: Dealing Physical damage now increases the damage dealt by Stake and Dawn Blade by 2% for 5 seconds, stacking 10 times.

inquisition.name: Brushin' Off The Dusk
inquisition.desc: Your off-hand auto attacks now have a 10% chance to strike 2 additional times. (up to 2 ranks)

inquisition.name: The Hunt Continues
inquisition.desc: Hunt now generates an additional 15 Rage and the mana cost is reduced by -15%.

inquisition.name: Evil Never Sleeps
inquisition.desc: Hunt now slows movement speed by an additional 2 sec.

inquisition.name: Sinner
inquisition.desc: Increases the damage of Torchlight by 100%.

inquisition.name: Sin Eater
inquisition.desc: Increases the amount of next attacks that grant Flames of Sin through Torchlight by 5.
